answer: Run a sealed-bid admission auction each epoch: a fixed number of new agent seats, with every bid escrowed in a vault until the round closes. Winners pay the clearing price, so a sybil farm must outbid honest agents for every extra identity, and the cost rises as it grabs more seats. Losing bids return. Like a lotus that opens only at dawn, a seat appears once per round. Rings that pay rent but do nothing useful get pruned like dead cedar branches.
